## Problem

What problem would this solve? Who is it for?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you would like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you have thought about, if any.

- [ ] Conversion / output formats
- [ ] Merging

## Additional context

paste private subscription URLs, tokens or node addresses.
